{{Infobox auto}}

'''Seitan''' is a meat substitute made from [[dough]]. It can't be eaten, but it can replace meat in [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]], [[lumpia]] and every [[stock]] that uses meat or fish, so that every oven meal has a vegetarian version.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/seitan.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, a [[Glass Bottle|water bottle]] (any potion is accepted) and a carrot, potato or dried kelp make 1 seitan. The glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref> Picking up dough unlocks the recipe.

== Trivia ==
* The changelog explains seitan was added "since I can't add soybeans".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Seitan (Since I can't add soybeans)}}</ref>
* The advancement for paneer makhani reminds the player that "All Foods have viable Vegetarian Options".
